_note: Maps the /ecosystem-brain:init interview answers to a tailored project config. Agent names are validated against catalog.json (github) or treated as local (security-auditor, test-writer, bug-fixer, memory-curator). Composed additively: build_types + rigor + sensitivity + stacks.

web.label: Web app
web.stack_blurb: Web application — UI + client-side state, talking to an API/data layer.

api.label: API service
api.stack_blurb: Backend API service — HTTP endpoints, business logic, persistence.

cli.label: CLI tool
cli.stack_blurb: Command-line tool — argument parsing, pure core logic, thin I/O shell.

library.label: Library / SDK
library.stack_blurb: Reusable library/SDK — pure functions, stable public API, strong tests.

prototype.label: Prototype
conventions: Move fast — favor working code over structure.
Tests are optional for throwaway spikes; add them once a direction sticks.
Skip CI until the shape stabilizes.

product.label: Product
conventions: Every public function has a docstring/JSDoc and at least one test.
Keep core logic pure; isolate I/O at the edges.
Run CI (lint + test) on every push.

production.label: Production
conventions: Full test coverage gate before merge; no untested public surface.
CI on push + observability (structured logs, error tracking).
Document every public API and its failure modes.
Review dependencies for CVEs; pin versions.

api-keys.label: Third-party API keys
security_rules: All keys live in `.env` (gitignored) — never hardcode, never log a key.
Provide `.env.example` with key names only (no values).
Rotate any key on suspected leak; gitleaks gates every commit.

pii.label: User data / PII
security_rules: Collect the minimum PII necessary; document why each field is stored.
Encrypt PII at rest and in transit; never log raw PII.
Define a data-retention/deletion policy and honor deletion requests.

money.label: Money / payments
security_rules: Treat all monetary logic as critical: validate and compute amounts server-side only.
Never trust client-supplied amounts; re-derive from source of truth.
Use idempotency keys on every write; audit-log every transaction.
Use integer minor units (cents), never floats, for money.

none.label: Nothing sensitive
security_rules: No secrets expected — keep it that way; gitleaks still gates commits.

react.label: React / Next.js
react.note: React 18 + Next.js (App Router). TypeScript strict, server components where sensible.

vue.label: Vue
vue.note: Vue 3 Composition API + Vite. TypeScript strict.

decide.label: Decide for me
decide.note: Stack chosen by the agent based on the requirements; default to React/Next unless a constraint says otherwise.
